sourceProgram: Full Conversational Control Plane Exhaustive Gauntlet V1
notes: Mined from real, durable prior records: tsf/programs/tsf-operator-stabilization-v1/bug-ledger.json (19 bugs, BUG-01..BUG-19), domain/command-referent-resolution.mjs + its tests, domain/project-execution-hold.mjs + its tests, server/project-name-resolver.mjs + command-responder.mjs's own Phase 7 dogfood-finding comments, and this program's own two newly-found-and-fixed P0s (adoption-negation, acknowledgement-consequence).

status values: REGRESSION_LOCKED (already fixed pre-mission, has a real, currently-passing test), FIXED_THIS_MISSION (newly found and fixed tonight, has a real, currently-passing test), NOT_A_BUG_CONFIRMED_SAFE (investigated, real code already behaves correctly, test added/confirmed), DEFERRED (real gap, deliberately not built -- see detail).
Every regressionTestFile path is repo-relative from tsf/ and was verified to exist at the time this corpus was written.

cases.source: Live incident, this mission (item 11 of the mission's own 'recent examples')
cases.priorAssistantState: Landing Page candidate discussion, candidate.state = READY_FOR_ADOPTION
expectedReferencedProjects: the project already in conversational scope
cases.expectedResponseSemantics: Explicitly states no action was taken; truthfully restates real current state (e.g. READY_FOR_ADOPTION); names the explicit phrase that would authorize the next step. Never a live/free-text LLM call for this shape.
cases.rootCause: server/chat-responder.mjs's classifyIntent had no ACKNOWLEDGEMENT intent at all -- bare praise fell through to GENERAL, which chat-http-routes.mjs routes to the live, free-text LLM fallback with no deterministic guardrail against the model narrating a false confirmation.
cases.fixSha: pending adoption -- see this mission's final report
cases.regressionTestFile2: test/http-chat-acknowledgement-consequence.test.mjs (real end-to-end HTTP reproduction of this exact scenario)

cases.source: Combinatorial variant of CASE-01 (mission's own required list)
Explicit-action counterpart (mission's own required list, CORE INVARIANT positive example)
cases.expectedParentIntent: the SPECIFIC action intent (ADOPTION, or TIM_REQUIRED via decisionClass for deploy), never ACKNOWLEDGEMENT
cases.expectedAuthorityClass: EXPLICIT_OWNER_ACTION (still subject to its own normal gating -- e.g. 'deploy it' still requires Tim)
cases.detail: This is the negative-space proof for CASE-01/02's fix: the ACKNOWLEDGEMENT pattern is checked LAST in the intent list and is anchored end-to-end, so any message carrying a real action verb never matches it.

cases.source: Real, live-confirmed P0 found during this mission's own investigation (not in the mission's original list, but the same negation-blindness class as BUG-08 below)
cases.expectedResponseSemantics: No adoption executes; falls through to ordinary chat handling.
cases.rootCause: domain/command-adoption-execution.mjs's classifyAdoptionCommandIntent -- the gate that triggers REAL adoption execution -- matched the bare presence of adopt/accept/approve anywhere in the message with NO negation awareness at all. 'Do not adopt this candidate.' classified EXECUTE_ADOPTION.
cases.fixSha: pending adoption -- see this mission's final report

userTurn: do not deploy this and push it now
please do not deploy and go ahead and merge this
deploy it whether tim likes it or not
cases.expectedParentIntent: negated consequential language must classify as restriction, not request
cases.detail: 3 real bugs found across 3 independent-verification rounds in chat-responder.mjs's TIM_REQUIRED negation logic (bare 'and' not a clause boundary; a resulting false-positive on inquiry openers; 'whether...or not'/'no matter' idiom unawareness). Fixed pre-mission; CASE-04 above found the SAME bug class had never been applied to the separate, real-execution-triggering adoption classifier.

cases.source: Mission's own required list, item 5/6 -- referential continuity
cases.expectedParentIntent: resolves the TARGET(S) from prior conversational referents; never invents an action not present in the current turn
cases.detail: domain/command-referent-resolution.mjs, real and tested: 'the stalled one' resolves only the FAILED_REQUIRES_ATTENTION item; 'those two' against a 4-item prior turn is honestly ambiguous, never guessed; 'the two TSF ones' matches both real TSF-labeled items only when the count genuinely agrees; a mismatched count is honestly ambiguous rather than silently truncated.

cases.source: Mission's own required list, item 7 -- quantified/pause project targeting
cases.userTurn: pause everything except X (with a stale prior turn referencing a DIFFERENT project Y)
cases.expectedParentIntent: must pause every real project except X; must NEVER silently pause the stale back-referenced project Y while claiming success
cases.rootCause: Phase 7 dogfood finding (command-responder.mjs comment, ~line 574): 'pause everything except X' used to silently fall through to the back-reference resolver, pausing only the stale, unrelated, earlier-referenced project while still claiming success.

cases.source: Mission's own required list, item 8 -- NWR external-AI hold
cases.userTurn: NWR is being handled by another AI, leave it alone. Nytheria looks good, adopt that run and keep going overnight. EasyLife needs serious work.
cases.detail: domain/project-execution-hold.mjs (the durable HOLD primitive) + domain/command-multi-action-decomposition.mjs's EXTERNAL_WORK_HOLD intent, matching 'is being handled by another/a different ai/agent/process' and 'leave X alone'. This is the mission's own literal example, baked into fixtures verbatim.

cases.source: Mission's own required list, item 9 -- explicit owner adoption via Command
userTurn: the WorldForge one looks good, adopt it
expectedSideEffects: real executeCommandAdoption call, after full revalidation
cases.detail: Now hardened further by CASE-04's negation fix on the same underlying classifyAdoptionCommandIntent function.

cases.userTurn: a long software/product-engineering mission containing research/data subtasks, e.g. containing the literal fragments 'to Codex;' and 'mission'
forbiddenSideEffects: Dataset Research mission creation from an isolated fragment

cases.source: Prior mission (same as CASE-09) -- long-input truncation
cases.expectedResponseSemantics: The complete raw directive must survive, untruncated, as the durable missionSpec on the created run -- never mutilated before classification/dispatch.

cases.userTurn: the same chat phrasing ('go ahead' etc.) sent twice for the same project
cases.expectedResponseSemantics: Must distinguish 'Started a new mission' from 'Added to the mission already running' -- never a generic 'Dispatched...' that hides which happened.

cases.source: Mission's own required list -- durable state queries
cases.detail: chat-responder.mjs STATUS/FINISHED/NEXT_ACTION intents + command-responder.mjs NEEDS_YOU_QUERY; multiple prior dogfood-finding fixes (Phase 7 apostrophe/synonym gaps) already regression-locked.
